scope: Independent source review of selected-store revision safeguards and the later Word workspace chrome timer

credential_v2.result: No concrete behavior/type regression found in source review. Queued calls capture selection revision; checks surround backend resolution; a started transaction uses one backend. Native generations discard stale loads, connection completion fences persistence, and opt-out fences catalog load/Forget. Execution remains separate.

workspace.finding: The new trailing 400 ms timer queued a post-frame callback through _rebuild without scheduling a frame. An idle workspace could defer the chrome refresh until unrelated activity. Request ensureVisualUpdate only from that timer callback.
workspace.regression: Advance the real production timer's fake clock without pumping a frame, require the 400 ms timer to schedule a frame, then verify the outline's edited heading and disposal cancellation.
workspace.other_review: Review and Notes panes retain their own controller listeners; selected proofing issue validation remains there. Timer and controller/proofing listener lifetimes are disposed consistently.
workspace.execution: Authored/reviewed source only; the validation runner will record red/green and final cohort outcomes separately.
